title: Happy Birthday, Arknights!
lines: Soon we will be celebrating Arknights' 2nd birthday, and we have all the Doctors' continued love and support to thank for that. To heat things up, all Doctors are invited to join in the Birthday Card Designing event. Feel free to write down your memories, expectations, or wishes for Arknights on the birthday card and send it off online. May our ark sail with all our hopes through the long nights.

Design your birthday card for Arknights at the website before submission. It will go through a quick review and your design will be presented on the website within 3 workdays. Once you share the link on Twitter/Facebook by clicking the share button on the website, you will have a chance to win the final reward.

Each participant may redesign their birthday cards up to 5 times. Besides, you may read others' birthday cards randomly presented to you (up to 10 cards per day and the limit will be lifted at the final phase of the event). What kinds of surprises are you going to encounter?
After the event concludes, 50 people randomly picked from those who have shared the link successfully will be awarded.

Note: The exact time of reward distribution will be notified via the official mail from arknights.event@yo-star.com . Please take care of your private info. Arknights EN is not responsible for any loss caused by mishandled private information.
Each submission must consist of customized text as well as stickers and background provided by the website. Cards that lack customized text or are filled with spam only will be invalidated.

Participants are required to submit their email addresses with their cards to ensure the smooth going of review notification and reward distribution. Please rest assured that email addresses are reserved for this event only.
Submissions with contents related to politics, violence, pornography, grotesque, or those violating the rules will be invalidated. Commercial contents are also prohibited.
Please report the works violating the rules to arknights.event@yo-star.com .
